name: add-finespacing-arm
desc: Add the v9 `finespacing` view as a fifth Raptor arm: raptor_ft_coatnet_v9_full.pt from dreaddevelopment/raptor-knee-finespacing. WHY THIS ONE, and not another view: (a) its geometry is DOCUMENTED, not inferred -- the dataset description states 80 slots (22/18/15/10/15) over 2-98 percent, 140 mm crop, 336 px, and k_eval 78; no public notebook carries a v9 ARMS entry, so without that description this would have been a guess. (b) It is the STRONGEST single model in the family: 0.932 public LB solo, vs 0.926/0.927 for the maxspan view we already ship, and its checkpoint reports 0.9031 on the 58 official labels (above the ~0.90 harm line). (c) The author explicitly names the pairing -- 'pair it with the wide span and wide dense checkpoints for a diversity boost' -- i.e. our v5 and v10. (d) It sits at the END of the sampling axis we measured as the only large lever: the author's own numbers are 44 slices 0.926 -> 64 0.928 -> 80 0.932, and his wide-span-44 result (0.917) independently reproduces our gap0 (-0.012). See FACTS C47/C48. The four shipped arms keep their exact ratios scaled by 0.8, so this isolates the addition.
